release_notes: V14.44 build 250 adds a live authenticated Web UI firmware-update progress page showing percentage, downloaded and total bytes, transfer speed, download verification, finalization and restart status. During OTA, Nightscout reads, trend backfill, WhatsApp requests, screen navigation and normal TFT drawing are paused to protect the update. Existing care-alarm abort handling, SHA-256 validation, native ESP-IDF image verification, boot-partition confirmation and restart safeguards remain active. B249 dynamic scaling for the 1-hour mini trend, selectable 1-to-12-hour glucose trend, insulin glucose overlay and IOB graph is retained.
